questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: The good and bad sides of social media, especially for young women
How to become a famous travel blogger
Why TikTok is so popular in the US
A new law banning social media in India
questions.why: They discuss the positives and negatives of social media and hear from young women in different countries.

questions.q: Why is this topic in the news, according to Beth?
options: Because of the US presidential election
Because a new app has been launched
Because Australia is debating a law limiting social media for under-16s
Because cyber-bullying has just been made illegal in many different countries
questions.why: She says a new law in Australia to limit under 16-year-olds' access is being debated.

questions.q: What good and bad things does Neil say about social media?
options: It helps him work, but it's expensive
It helps him meet lots of new people, but it can also be dangerous
It's fun, but it's full of false news
He can see what distant friends do, but it wastes lots of time
questions.why: He can see what friends far away are doing, but it's 'really addictive and a massive waste of time'.

questions.q: Why does Beth say it's interesting to hear a man's perspective?
options: Because men use social media more
Because young women are often most affected by things like cyber-bullying
Because Neil is an expert on social media
Because men usually refuse to talk honestly about their use of social media
questions.why: She says that with issues like cyber-bullying, 'it's often young women who are most affected'.

questions.q: According to student Haleigh Hurst, what is one benefit of social media?
options: It helps young people find jobs and internships in politics
It teaches young voters about policies and starts debates
It stops people arguing about politics
It makes elections cheaper
questions.why: She says it has played a huge role in educating young voters and has sparked more debates.

questions.q: What does Haleigh say about Donald Trump?
options: He has said he is fond of TikTok
He wants to ban TikTok in the United States
He never uses social media
He criticised young voters
questions.why: She says Trump said he has 'a soft spot in his heart for TikTok'.

questions.q: What problem does model Maanvi Sharma describe?
options: Her followers copy her clothes
She has lost a lot of money and some modelling work because of Instagram
Partners may leave her because they feel uneasy about her online fame
Her family won't let her use social media
questions.why: She says the person you're dating might leave because of social media and feel intimidated.

questions.q: What does travel blogger Kemi Adeyemi say some people want her to do?
options: Post many more photos and videos of her travels
Stop travelling abroad
Speak up more about politics
Make herself smaller so they can feel bigger
questions.why: She says some people 'want you to shrink yourself so that they can… be the bigger person'.
